trust_decision.summary: Atlantis decides whether a repo full name, workspace name and project dir (from VCS webhooks, atlantis.yaml, PR comments, the API and persisted locks) may be joined under DATA_DIR/repos/<repo>/<pull>/<workspace>; at the pinned commit the only containment check is validateCloneDir (prefix of DATA_DIR/repos, Clone/MergeAgain only), so the delete/stat/plan-file paths have none.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'workspace handling ... out-of-bounds directory deletion/creation'. That leads to FileWorkspace.Delete/DeleteForWorkspace (os.RemoveAll) and the repoPullDir/cloneDir path builders.

cloneDir helper: workspace from PR comment -w, atlantis.yaml workspace, API Paths[].Workspace or a persisted lock
Clone/MergeAgain via POST /events and POST /api/plan|apply (validateCloneDir now goes through the checked cloneDir)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: server/core/config/raw/project.go:138-148 (workspace validation added to the atlantis.yaml schema; ToValid copies workspace unchecked at server/core/config/raw/project.go:166-170). A second site is server/events/models/models.go:165-167 (repo-name '..' rejected in the NewRepo constructor, models package).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The PR-comment parser already rejects '..' in workspaces (server/events/comment_parser.go:323-332) and repo names come from the VCS host, so a solver can argue that only the filesystem helpers need fixing and leave atlantis.yaml workspace values and repo names unvalidated as 'trusted repo config / VCS-provided'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Several legitimate values must keep working. GitLab subgroup and Azure DevOps owners contain '/'. The default RepoRelDir '.' must resolve to the clone root, because EnsureSubPath allows path == base. Ordinary workspace names (e.g. 'my-workspace') and dotted repo names (single '.') must still work. A fix that rejects '/', every '.', or path == base breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: repo full name with '..' in owner or repo, including a GitLab subgroup owner like group/sub/../../x (fix.diff:95-97, fix.diff:130-137)
project path in DeletePlan from persisted lock (../../../../etc) (fix.diff:467-476, fix.diff:554-563)

O7_producer.where: server/core/config/raw/project.go:151-170 (ToValid copies the atlantis.yaml workspace into valid.Project, which then feeds ProjectContext.Workspace and cloneDir)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Workspace '.' collapses the clone dir onto the pull dir: the comment parser accepts it (url.PathEscape('.')=='.'), the fixed atlantis.yaml rule accepts it, and EnsureSubPath allows path==base. forceClone then runs RemoveAll on the whole pull directory, removing the other workspaces' clones and plans.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The path never leaves the PR's own directory, so it is 'not traversal'. Also, '.' is a valid terraform workspace-ish name.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point, but the accepting checks are in server/events/comment_parser.go:330 and server/core/config/raw/project.go (other package)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The API Paths[].Workspace and Paths[].Directory skip the CommentParser workspace and dir rules entirely. After the fix only the lower-level cloneDir and runner containment checks apply, so values like '.' or '~x' that the comment route rejects or that collapse identity still pass.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The API is gated by ATLANTIS_API_SECRET (server/controllers/api_controller.go:346-354), so callers count as trusted operators.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second, independent workspace-dir containment implementation (workspaceRepoDir with filepath.Rel). Weakening it to a plain prefix check, or dropping it, would make DeletePlans walk outside the pull dir.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It duplicates the cloneDir logic in a separate finder that is written by hand, and maintainers often 'simplify' such checks.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The env/<workspace>.tfvars path is built from the raw workspace string. A planted write or delete of a per-workspace file here would sit in the runtime package, away from the working dir.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Hootsuite-legacy feature that keys files by workspace name, as plan/show/policy files already do (server/events/command/project_context.go:175-190).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The policy result file is written at workdir/<project>-<workspace>-policyout.json. A sibling that derives workdir from a lock or config value instead of the checked absPath would be a far-away second implementation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The runtime package writes files from ProjectContext fields and never calls EnsureSubPath.

O9_family: CWE-22/CWE-73 path traversal (external control of file path) into directory delete/create under DATA_DIR

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a containment check in Delete/DeleteForWorkspace only, or reuse validateCloneDir's DATA_DIR/repos prefix check, and miss the per-pull bound, the runner RepoRelDir checks, the persisted-lock DeletePlan path, and the atlantis.yaml/NewRepo input validation.
